d:
Celebrate World Coconut Day with a delicious collection of recipes that showcase the incredible versatility of coconut!
From creamy and comforting Coconut Rice to crispy Coconut Kadhi with Pakodas, flavourful Coconut Rasam, refreshing Coconut Pineapple Ice Cream, and indulgent Coconut Poli — this episode is packed with exciting ways to enjoy this everyday ingredient.
In this episode:
Coconut Rice with Chickpea & Broccoli
Coconut Kadhi with Crispy Pakodas
Creamy Coconut Rasam
Coconut Pineapple Ice Cream
Coconut Poli with Jaggery
